title: feat(textiles-handloom): implement Enterprise Indian Textiles & Handloom Heritage Explorer Suite
body:
### Summary
This issue tracks the implementation of the **Enterprise Indian Textiles & Handloom Heritage Explorer Suite** — an interactive dashboard for exploring India's regional fabrics, weaving techniques, and master artisans.

### Features Implemented
- 🧵 **Fabrics Gallery** — 14 regional fabrics (silk, cotton, wool, blend) with material, origin, and feature metadata
- 🪡 **Weaving Techniques** — 12 techniques across weaving, dyeing, embroidery, and printing categories
- 👨‍🎨 **Master Artisans Database** — 12 legendary artisans with Padma/National Award recognition
- 📊 **Analytics Dashboard** — State-wise distribution, material breakdown, technique categories, and heritage timeline
- 🔍 **Global Search & Filter** — Multi-term fuzzy search with category filters, sub-filters, and sorting

### Technical Details
- **HTML** (292 lines): Glassmorphic dark-mode dashboard with ARIA landmarks and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
- **CSS** (757 lines): Responsive glassmorphic styling with CSS custom properties, animated weave-pattern hero, and mobile breakpoints
- **JavaScript** (665 lines): Class-based `TextileEngine` with filtering, sorting, search, and analytics
- **Tests** (600 lines): 71 Vitest unit tests covering all engine methods, models, filters, analytics, and render functions

### Total Line Count: 2,314 lines

### Labels & Keywords
`textiles`, `handloom`, `weaving`, `indian-heritage`, `frontend`, `dashboard`, `analytics`, `ready-for-review`
